title: Roger Wolf Kahn as bandleader

blocks.x: I used to work for him.
Tell me what kind, Roger Wolf Kahn, what kind of a person was he? What kind of a musician was he?
Well he was a very good musician.
What did he play? It was the clarinet?
How was he as a leader?
As a leader, he was okay.
Do you remember anything about the band?
